title: Interval hypergraphic polytopes (or deformed associahedra), Tamari interval posets, and weeping willows
summary: For a hypergraph $\mathbb{H}$ on $[n]$, the hypergraphic polytope $\triangle_{\mathbb{H}}$ is the Minkowski sum of the standard simplices $\triangle_H$ for all $H \in \mathbb{H}$. We focus here on interval hypergraphs, where all hyperedges are intervals of $[n]$. They are precisely the deformations of Loday's associahedron. Their vertex posets are Tamari interval posets, and we describe which Tamari interval poset appears as a vertex poset in which interval hypergraphic polytope.
